scope: Offline disassembly of the profiling executable with complete machine-code identity to the timed binary. Static paths and collapsed sampled PCs do not establish instruction frequencies or per-instruction elapsed time.
extraction: Retain file/section header and the exact requested symbol through the instruction before the next symbol label.
sampled_PC_scope: The retained worker groups map listed native PCs to entry tests, SIMD-mask extraction and stack accesses. Groups collapse multiple or undisplayed PCs; no individual instruction is assigned the group count.
